messages:
alex: Canary deploy for group A finished (tag=canary-2026-03-21-a). Starting post-deploy verification run now. sending smokewave sequencer :rocket:

deploy-bot: sequencer kicked off id=sv-9901 step=post-deploy-smoke vehicles=4

rita: quick health peek: p50=28ms p95=195ms error_rate=0.04% (tiny 5xx blip at 22:07 UTC), no sustained 429s

oncall-liz: noticed p95 bumps from a small subset of eu1 hosts, looks correlated to eu1-quant2. checking host CPU and io

sam: running a short, targeted synth against the short prompt suite (B) with concurrency 4 to reproduce tail. snippet: ```curl -X POST https://internal-smoke/api/run -d '{"suite":"short-b","concurrency":4}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_KEY"```

infra-bot: synth job queued -> running (target=eu1-shadow) id=sv-9901-s1

rita: logs show two GC-ish stall messages from the inference runtime around 22:09:03 on pod eu1-quant2-201 and eu1-quant2-203. also seeing shorter-than-usual KV warmup windows

alex: given the autoscaler activity earlier during the change window (21:55-22:05), my hunch is cache churn from scale-down/scale-up. proposal: hold roll-forward 18m, trigger a kv-prefill bump on affected hosts, re-run targeted synth. If p95>250ms or >0.5% synth errors and failures still host-correlated -> pin to previous variant and start rollback.

sam: +1. I'll post the prefill snippet for eu1-quant2: ```for h in eu1-quant2-201 eu1-quant2-203; do curl -sS "http://$h/internal/warm?keys=sample1,sample2" || echo "warm fail $h"; done```

rita: synth sv-9901-s1 finished: 100 reqs, success 98, p95 260ms, avg 70ms, 5xx=2 (both from eu1-quant2-201). failures show identical stack trace -> nique host error

oncall-liz: infra timeline confirms autoscaler removed 2 instances at 21:58:12 then re-added at 22:01:40. that aligns with the hosts in question

infra-bot: running kv-prefill bump job id=prefill-9901 targets=eu1-quant2-201,eu1-quant2-203

alex: note for release notes: "Canary: runtime optimizations + small qkv patch". We should add an incident blurb if we end up pinning. For now we delay broader rollout and keep the change window flag set until green

sam: re-run synth against only those hosts now: ```curl -X POST https://internal-smoke/api/run -H 'X-Target-Hosts: eu1-quant2-201,eu1-quant2-203' -d '{"suite":"short-b","concurrency":2}'```

rita: targeted synth done: 40 reqs, success 40, p95 120ms, avg 45ms, 0 failures. looks like prefill helped on those hosts

alex: ok, gradient decision: continue hold for remaining 6m to make sure metrics steady. if p95 remains <200ms and synth error 0 -> proceed to expand canary to group B per rollout plan. If regression returns -> pin to v2026-03-20-9 and run rollback playbook. tagging ops@release for visibility

oncall-liz: sounds good. Ill keep monitoring dashboards and post final thumbs up here

rita: adding short note to the release notes draft: "Observed transient p95 regressions tied to autoscale-induced cache churn in eu1; kv-prefill bump mitigated the issue. No user-facing impact observed."

alex: thanks all — keeping change window open until 22:30 UTC. Will post final status before we expand.
